title: LendingPad Console

listing.shortDescription: A dense data dashboard for managing loan index updates — sign-in, dashboard views, index search, lists, audit trails and logs, built with MUI and AG Grid.
listing.fullDescription: LendingPad is an internal-style console for mortgage index management. Built with React, Material UI and AG Grid, it delivers the kind of dense, keyboard-friendly data screens the lending industry expects: an authenticated dashboard, index search with filters, list views, a full audit trail and log browsing — all wired with Formik forms and React Router.

cover.imageAlt: LendingPad Console — Mortgage Index Management Dashboard

closing.conclusion: The index-management console gave the lending team a fast, familiar way to search, audit and track loan indexes — a dense data UI that feels like the desktop tools the industry already trusts.

challenge.summary: Loan index data is dense, compliance-sensitive and unforgiving of UI friction. The console had to feel like the desktop tools the industry already trusts — not another web app.

points.title: Dense data
points.description: Hundreds of rows with many columns, needing grids that handle it.

points.title: Auditability
points.description: Every change needed a trail for compliance review.

points.title: Speed of use
points.description: Analysts need search and filters without page reloads.

solution.summary: The answer was the pattern the industry knows: a tight grid at the centre, powerful search on top, and an audit trail underneath.

points.title: AG Grid at the core
points.description: Sortable, filterable grids that handle dense index data.

points.title: Structured search
points.description: Index search across the full dataset with instant results.

points.title: Audit everywhere
points.description: Changes and logs recorded and browsable.

points.title: Gated entry
points.description: Sign-in before any index data renders.
